findings.fix: Move it into a separate lemma, e.g. `eventually_differentiableAt_chart_comp_of_eventually_mdifferentiableAt`, taking charts e, d, c in the maximal atlases and the source-membership hypotheses, and use it here.
findings.issue: `hg` (lines 77–89) shows that the chart representative of an eventually MDifferentiable map in maximal-atlas charts is differentiable near the point. Nothing in it depends on the implicit-function setting, and it makes the proof run past 50 lines.

findings.evidence: Lines 104–114 use only the chart memberships, htarget, and hφ, chaining mdifferentiableAt_symm_of_mem_maximalAtlas, mdifferentiableAt_prod_module_iff and mdifferentiableAt_of_mem_maximalAtlas. Nothing ties them to G.
findings.fix: Move it into a companion lemma, stated for `fun p ↦ d.symm (φ (e p.1, c p.2))`, next to the `hg` lemma, so the main proof only handles the solved-form transport.
findings.issue: `hψ` (lines 104–114) is the reverse of `hg`: a map that is eventually differentiable on model spaces, pulled back through maximal-atlas charts, is eventually MDifferentiable. It is also general and is inlined.

summary: The 76-line main proof contains two general chart-transport steps (differentiability of the chart representative, and the pull-back of a differentiable model map through maximal-atlas charts) that should be helper lemmas rather than inlined.
